mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ledger_transactions ( card_id, type, direction, amount, fee_amount, balance_before, balance_after, category_id, description, reference, transaction_date, transfer_group_id, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{cardId}, #{type}, #{direction}, #{amount}, #{feeAmount}, #{balanceBefore}, #{balanceAfter}, #{categoryId}, #{description}, #{reference}, #{transactionDate}, #{transferGroupId}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ledger_transactions WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE ledger_transactions SET is_void = TRUE, void_reason = #{voidReason}, voided_at = #{voidedAt}, voided_by = #{voidedBy, typeHandler=com.edinar.control.config.UuidTypeHandler}, updated_at = #{voidedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_void = FALSE
